meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

copy.tagline: 在编码前先编写测试用例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你习惯先写测试再实现功能
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before implementing features or fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you follow test-driven development practice

howto.what: 当实现新功能或修复bug时，Claude会先写一个会失败的测试，然后写最简代码让它通过，并循环红-绿-重构步骤。
howto.when: 当用户要求实现新功能、修复bug、重构或改变行为时触发。

say.text: 请帮我实现用户登录功能，先写测试再写代码。
say.note: Claude会先写一个针对登录的失败测试。

say.text: 修复这个bug：当邮箱为空时应该报错，请先写测试。
say.note: Claude会先写重现bug的测试，确认失败后修复。

howto.what_en: When implementing a feature or fixing a bug, Claude writes a failing test first, then minimal code to pass, following the red-green-refactor cycle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to implement new features, fix bugs, refactor, or change behavior.

say_en.text: Implement user login, write test first then code.
say_en.note: Claude writes a failing test for login first.

say_en.text: Fix bug: empty email should error, write test first.
say_en.note: Claude writes a failing test reproducing the bug, then fixes.
